system.name: GRAPE
system.one_liner: Food recommender that feeds items' sustainability indicators into an attention module and trains with a normal loss plus a green loss.

content.variant_note: inputs, embedding layers, a large attention module and the prediction in one tinted region, with a green side panel that contrasts the loss designs
content.argues: Sustainability indicators can be fused into the recommender through attention and trained with a green loss, with or without priorities among indicators, next to the normal loss.
content.subject: Target item and user history with green values, embedding, a sustainability-integrated attention module, prediction, and the normal and green losses.

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each stage its own hue family and reserve one hue (green) for the quantity the paper is about, carried through inputs, profile, scores and the loss panel; explain a comparison loss with a see-saw and happy or sad faces next to the item icons.
lessons.suits: recommender or ranking models with an extra attribute channel and a custom loss, where item icons and a loss panel make the idea concrete.

evidence: GRAPE consists of three main modules: the Embedding Module, the Sustainability Integrated Attention Module, and the Prediction Module.
the Normal Loss, which aims to enhance recommendation accuracy
For the item’s sustainability indicators, a deeper color signifies a greener value.

summary: GRAPE is a food recommender that takes sustainability into account. The figure draws the whole model and its loss in two tinted regions. At the left, a target item and a user's interaction history are shown as clip-art dishes with green-value glyphs (circles and pentagons, deeper green for greener values), summarised by Mean and Std rows. Item and green embedding layers give peach embedding grids; the large blue Sustainability Integrated Attention Module applies self- and cross-attention, item and green fusion, a product node and a feed-forward layer; blue output grids are combined with a green user profile P[u] to give the score. The green panel at the right explains the loss as Normal Loss plus Green Loss, using face icons for preferred items and see-saws for the non-prioritized and prioritized green losses.
summary_zh: GRAPE 的模型结构图：左侧用菜品图标和绿色圆形、五边形表示目标物品与用户历史，经嵌入层和蓝色的可持续性融合注意力模块得到预测分数；右侧绿色面板用笑脸、哭脸和跷跷板解释普通损失与两种绿色损失。
notes: Kinds extend the prior (model-anatomy) with side-by-side-contrast for the loss panel (non-prioritized versus prioritized green loss). The wiring near the score node (blue tile panel, green strip, P[u] and the second peach panel) is dense and read only at a coarse level; the see-saw semantics are read from the drawing, since the paper text gives only the module list and the caption. The bottom Initialize line is read as the route from the Mean and Std table to P[u].
